title: Baza Prime
extract:
The Baza Prime is the Prime variant of the  Baza silenced submachine gun. In addition to improved Critical Chance and Status Chance, it has higher Magazine Size and reserve ammo, faster Reload Speed, and longer Damage Falloff range, reducing downtime from frequent reloading while increasing its effective range. Baza Prime was released alongside  Ivara Prime and  Aksomati Prime.

Characteristics
This Weapon deals primarily  Puncture Damage.
This Weapon is Silent.
Low Zoom when aiming.
Shorter Damage Falloff distance for a hit-scan Weapon.
Advantages over other Primary   weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Very high Accuracy per shot, even at full auto.
Negligible Recoil.
Silent nature allows for stealth usage.
Lower Zoom allows for a more stable view.

Acquisition

Vaultings
On December 10th, 2021, it was announced that Baza Prime, along with  Ivara Prime and  Aksomati Prime, would enter the Prime Vault and be retired from the reward tables on December 15th, 2021. Any preexisting components or fully-built items will remain as is.

Tips

The Baza's high accuracy allows it to land headshots consistently compared to other automatic weapons, which along with its good critical hit chance makes it ideal for builds using  Argon Scope.
Its lower status chance compared to some other automatic rifles can be alleviated with the  Hunter Munitions mod, allowing the weapon to spread  Slash procs rapidly to enemies, which helps the weapon a lot versus heavy armor.
Its silenced nature makes it synergize well with  Ivara, as firing the weapon will not interrupt her  Prowl ability.
Since the Baza has very high accuracy, it can use Heavy Caliber with almost no drawback and increasing the weapon's overall damage output.

Notes
Tied with  Soma/ Soma Prime,  Attica, and  Baza for the highest Critical Multiplier of all fully automatic rifles.
Tied with  Baza for the third fastest Fire Rate of all fully automatic rifles, behind  Grakata and  Prisma Grakata.
Fastest Reload Speed of all fully automatic rifles.
Tied with  Baza for the fourth lowest base Damage of all fully automatic rifles, after  Prisma Grakata,  Soma/ Soma Prime, and  Grakata; very reliant on its high Critical Damage potential.
